hypothesis: A covariance fitted to matched same-target consensus effects from multiple source donors better matches the geometry of an equal-donor predictor than covariance fitted to stacked donor-private effects.

basis.row_rule: Use the sorted exact perturbation-name intersection across every donor in the role, then remove the complete forbidden target-name union before loading any fitted row values.
basis.donor_centering: For each donor and role, compute the mean only over the explicitly allowed matched rows on the response axis.
basis.donor_normalization: For each donor and role, compute the median L2 norm only over its allowed centered matched rows. Renormalize donors to the median of those role-local donor medians.
basis.consensus: Take the equal arithmetic mean of the allowed, centered, role-renormalized same-target rows.
basis.consensus_centering: Subtract the consensus mean computed only over those same allowed consensus rows.
basis.covariance: M.T @ M / n over the allowed, centered consensus basis only.

numerical_rank.acceptance: Every one of the 4992 raw covariance eigenvalues must be finite and strictly greater than the numerical-rank tolerance. A rows-greater-than-columns check is not evidence of rank.
numerical_rank.failure_policy: fail closed before writing the final v2 directory

memory.internal_monitor: Use process_rss and free_percent from experiments/144-consensus-covariance/memory_guard.py for fail-closed checkpoints around every source loader, fitted statistic, covariance and eigensolver boundary, hash pass, serializer, and finalization
memory.external_monitor: experiments/144-consensus-covariance/memory_guard.py continuously samples the isolated process group every 0.25 seconds and is mandatory with limits at least as strict as the authorization
memory.live_supervision_proof: Before source loading, run.py must complete a two-way request-response handshake over inherited pipe descriptors created by the bound external wrapper
memory.monitor_failure_policy: A process-table error, unavailable free-memory measurement, orphaned descendant, interrupt, RSS violation, or free-memory violation terminates the complete guarded process group; termination is verified after SIGTERM and escalated to SIGKILL if members remain

v1_quarantine.exact_directory_membership_required: Every entry recursively below work/preoutcome-v1 must match the frozen file set; unexpected files, directories, symlinks, or other entries fail quarantine
